svg.title: Your West Side subway connections
svg.desc: MTA map with routes 1, A, B, C, D, N, Q, R and W emphasized. Other routes and the city map are faded. Highlighted stations: 59 Street–Columbus Circle and 57 Street–7 Avenue. Shared route trunks follow the official MTA geometry; weekday service varies.

g.aria-label: Highlighted route corridors for 1, A, C, B, D, N, Q, R and W
